entities.name: Lipoteichoic acid synthase
observations: 646 aa bacterial membrane enzyme; exact sequence hash match to reviewed UniProt Q49VR4 from Staphylococcus saprophyticus.
Reference function: polymerizes lipoteichoic acid polyglycerol phosphate, presumably using phosphatidylglycerol as substrate.
Reference localization: cell membrane and extracellular/secreted-facing annotation; multi-pass membrane protein.
Sequence-derived properties: calculated molecular weight 74,911 Da, theoretical pI 6.50, GRAVY -0.424, instability index 35.5.
Pfam domains: LtaS_N PF27449 at residues 5-215 and Sulfatase PF00884 at residues 247-539.

entities.name: Q49VR4
observations: Reviewed UniProt reference protein from Staphylococcus saprophyticus; 100% identity and 100% coverage to the query, with exact sequence hash match.
Annotated as lipoteichoic acid synthase involved in lipoteichoic acid biosynthesis and staphylococcal growth/cell division.

entities.name: Lipoteichoic acid biosynthesis
observations: The protein is annotated to GO:0070395, lipoteichoic acid biosynthetic process.
